# PathWeave — full reference

> PathWeave is a management consulting and advisory firm founded in April 2020. It helps founders and leadership teams strengthen the systems behind growth: sales processes, CRM, data and dashboards, HR and people systems, roles, operating routines and execution. Website: https://pathweave.in/

This file summarises facts published on pathweave.in. Where it quotes outcomes from a founder's earlier career, those are employer results from before PathWeave, not PathWeave client results. Last reviewed: 7 October 2026.

## Identity

- Official name: PathWeave
- Brand line: Strategy. Transformation. Growth.
- Type: Management consulting and advisory firm
- Founded: April 2020
- Website: https://pathweave.in/
- Email: growth@pathweave.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 77008 83315
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pathweave-consulting
- Geography: Primary market Hyderabad and Secunderabad (Telangana, India). Local offices in Nagpur and Bhopal. Remote consulting support for Indore and Delhi NCR.

## Positioning

Growth problems are often systems problems. PathWeave works on the connected pieces — people, processes, data, technology and execution — rather than treating them as isolated functional fixes. It works mainly with growing SMEs, promoter-led companies and mid-market businesses moving from founder-led decisions to structured management.

## Framework: the PW-3 Sutra

People, Process and Technology are designed together:
- People: roles, ownership, capability and the leaders who run the change.
- Process: workflows, reviews and decision rights that make work repeatable.
- Technology: CRM, HR systems, data and dashboards that make work visible.

## Method

Diagnose → Design → Implement → Enable → Measure. PathWeave diagnoses before prescribing, designs for the real organisation, supports implementation where required, builds ownership with the client team, and sets practical measures for adoption and outcomes.

## Focused entry offers

- HR Health Check — https://pathweave.in/peopleos/hr-health-check/ — one HR area (HR operations, policies and compliance, performance management, recruitment, organisation and role clarity, HRMS and HR processes, employee lifecycle).
- Sales & CRM Health Check — https://pathweave.in/businessos/sales-crm-health-check/ — one focus (CRM requirements, sales process optimisation, distributor health, city expansion).
- Both: small fixed price agreed upfront; outputs are a gap map, prioritised fixes, a recommended next step and an optional implementation scope. Continuing with PathWeave is optional.
- Free readiness assessment — https://pathweave.in/diagnostic/ — 15 questions, about 5 minutes, indicative scores across People, Process and Technology; responses are calculated in the browser.

## Founders

### Srrinivas Sharrma — Founder, leads BusinessOS
https://pathweave.in/about/srrinivas-sharrma/
Business leader with 18+ years across revenue growth, sales transformation, Sales Excellence, Commercial Excellence, sales operations, CRM and go-to-market execution.
- Agro Tech Foods and PepsiCo: frontline and regional sales; at PepsiCo led the Maharashtra premium beverage business (Tropicana, Gatorade, Himalayan); Tropicana market share moved from 44% to 52% in that role.
- Kohler India: led Retail and Projects across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, including 5× retail growth over four years; later national Sales Development, then Business Process Excellence – Commercial. National Salesforce adoption covered four regions, 150+ Sales and Marketing employees and 500+ dealers.
- Info Edge (Naukri.com): Senior Vice President – Sales Planning & Excellence; led Microsoft Dynamics CRM adoption across 700+ sales users and 11 branches.

### Renu Dhanopia Sharma — Founder, leads PeopleOS
https://pathweave.in/about/
HR leadership, consulting and outsourced HR delivery across organisation structures, policies, recruitment, performance management, HR operations and people systems.
